prompt: Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density. Match the palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle of the attached reference sprites exactly. EDIT the attached player sheet, preserve character design and 3-column 4-row layout. Fix row TWO column THREE to face LEFT like the other two figures in row TWO, with opposite leg forward from column TWO. Row THREE stays entirely facing RIGHT. Remove ALL background glow and backdrop: genuinely transparent empty pixels, no shadow or halo. Keep all twelve character silhouettes intact, dark crisp outlines, exact same size throughout. Simplify shading to flat chunky color clusters, no gradients. Rows DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, UP. Columns idle, step A, step B. Each character fits a 16x24 logical cell. No other changes.
notes: Art export reviewed at 1x and 4x. Rows down,left,right,up; columns idle,stepA,stepB. Foot anchor is cell-local at lower edge. Loader/animation registration and manifest integration belong to issue #1. Source RGB may show glow when alpha is ignored; export uses hard alpha >=128 and canonical transparent RGB.

export.method: Threshold alpha at 128; find 4 occupied row bands and 3 occupied column bands per row; crop each frame to alpha content; preserve aspect ratio and nearest-neighbour fit within 14x22; centre horizontally and bottom-align in 16x24 cells; assemble 48x96 sheet; median-cut quantize to 23 RGB colors with dithering disabled; restore hard alpha and zero transparent RGB.
export.palette: Per-sheet median-cut from reference-matched generated art, <=23 opaque colors plus transparent.
